answer: The three words are derived from a 69 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. Because the beacon nonce is published only after close, the dawn audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate bridge derivation per key. That is 28 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
